name: promo-cleanup
description: Labels marketing mail and archives it when Jev is confident. Screens out mail from real people first.

from_a_person.instructions: This email was written personally by a real person to the recipient, not sent by a company or an automated system.

category.instructions: What kind of email is this?

criteria.promo: Marketing, sales, deals or newsletters the recipient did not ask a question about
criteria.receipt: A purchase, payment, booking or shipping confirmation
criteria.notification: An automated alert or update from a service the recipient uses
criteria.personal: A message from a real person

fits_category.instructions: One of these clearly describes this email: marketing, receipt, service notification, personal message.

decisions.name: Never touch mail from real people
